items.title: Iran to highlight war-related environmental damage at COP31
items.summary: TEHRAN - At the 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31) in Turkey, Iran will present documented reports on the environmental damage caused by war, highlighting its impacts on infrastructure and human health. The country will also seek to advance its environmental priorities, particularly those concerning the impacts of climate change, on the international stage.

ai.sum: Iran says it will present reports on war-related environmental damage at the COP31 climate summit hosted in Turkey.
